Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking our introductory call yesterday. As discussed, MedAlign is ready to run a three-week POC but we have two gating items from our security and procurement teams:

- Data residency: all production and test data must stay within US-only VPCs controlled by MedAlign.
- Evidence: we need a redacted SOC 2 report and answers to a short security questionnaire before procurement signs off.

To make the POC feasible we are asking if Redwood can provide pilot credits that cover the estimated infra spend (approx. $10k–$18k depending on token use). The POC will run in our VPC (Private deployment) and will use batching/quantization recommendations you mentioned.

I've attached a short security questionnaire and a redacted SOC 2 snapshot for your review. Can you confirm the process and any information your security team needs? Also please outline the approval path for credits for Private/VPC pilots.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement would like an answer before the end of next week.

Best,

MedAlign

Policy context (for approval):
- We typically approve up to $15,000 in pilot credits for security-gated Private POCs when: SOC2 evidence is provided, PM/Eng owner signs an internal acceptance form, and Finance has a charge-back code.
- Anything above $15k needs VP signoff.

- Preconditions: Signed pilot MSA addendum (DocuSign link below), basic trial onboarding call with our infra engineer, and a short post-trial review to capture quantization/batching recommendations.
- Activation: use this activation link to redeem credits — https://app.redwood.ai/credits/activate/DA-4589 (expires in 21 days).

Attachments: POC-credits-activation-instructions.pdf (contains activation steps and contact for infra engineer).

Next steps for MedAlign:
- Sign pilot MSA addendum: https://www.docusign.com/link/pilot-MSA-DA-4589
- Confirm preferred time for a 30-min onboarding with our infra lead (I have availability Tue/Wed next week).
- Send final token/usage estimate (so we monitor spend and avoid early exhaustion).

If anything changes on the sensitivity (PHI) front, please flag immediately — that will require a short InfoSec review and may change the subsidy terms.

I'll mark this thread as approved and Monica will issue the internal coupon. Congratulations — looking forward to the POC.

Best regards,
